body:
Your ask: "we need Veterinarian, give 4 options, I will choose". You kept all 4 = staff of 4.
In THIS update, stage 4 (your decision 30 Oct: sickness + vet go in now).
Same people style as the townsfolk and farmers. All wear a stethoscope and a white name badge with a red cross.
- Nurse Penny (was Dr. Mila's look): white coat, clipboard, lobby desk
- Dr. Tomas: teal scrubs, white collar, paw-print pocket, a dog treat
- Dr. Rūta: older, grey bun, round glasses, white coat, carrying a kitten
- Vet nurse Leo: lilac scrubs with white paw prints, a bandage roll
The lobby nurse (books visits, gives treats) is a separate entry: Lobby nurse.
Model Compare: Pet clinic → Veterinarian.

comments.text: Viewer: 3 passes + final, all four 8/10. Left (minor): Mila's coat back looks pale grey in the light; small pocket flap under the badge.

Done: moved to this update, stage 4.
Lobby nurse is a new model (own entry).
Approved: you decided it in Model Compare (31 Oct).
Done: final 4 = Penny (lobby), Tomas, Rūta (the vet), Leo (treat). No Dr. Mila.

short: 4 vets kept; they go in this update (stage 4)
source: chat 30 Oct: Living things models, round 33
title: Veterinarian: 4 vets to choose from
